limits: Two owned inert packages with an application and exact transitive dependency, one explicit flat-container origin, one macOS ARM64 server, real local PostgreSQL 16.16 and IPv4 and IPv6 loopback HTTP. The registry makes six requests to one origin for two version indexes, two nupkg files and two SHA-512 sidecars. Warm requests after process restart make zero origin requests. Hosted integration regressions, release gates and other NuGet operations have separate records. Public and private remote feeds, production TLS, alternative clients, groups, metadata discovery and larger workloads remain open.
